_comment: Registry of unimplemented/blocked capabilities. Demo tests covering these features must NOT be marked as production-capability passing. See P20 item 9/10b/20/29 for details.

blocked_capabilities.reason: Backend needs new resource/placement tables and API (/api/resource, /api/placement). Features/channels.tsx resource snapshot and placement editing only stored in localStorage.
Requires external SMS gateway service. Phone binding and verification code flow use client-side fake authentication (lib/demo-auth.ts, sessionStorage).
Recharge flow uses manual payment result selection (simulate success/failure/expiry). No real payment gateway integration. The begin/resolve endpoints are wired but resolve is triggered manually.

lib/billing.ts localStorage persistence (veyra-billing-demo-v1) is deeply coupled with product-preview.ts demo store initialization. 25+ test cases directly assert localStorage round-trip behavior. Removal requires simultaneous refactor of demo store init logic and full test suite.
blocked_capabilities.blocker: Deep coupling with demo store; requires full refactor

rules: Demo tests that exercise these capabilities must NOT be marked as production-capability passing in test reports.
Test reports must explicitly list which capabilities are unverified/blocked.
When a blocked capability becomes implemented, move it out of this file and add production tests.
